exposure: Start-up time of lactation phase II
cohort: 45 premature infants admitted to the NICU and their mothers
finding: Maternal age, delivery mode, gestational age, history of gestational hypertension, EPDS score, postnatal first milk-feeding time, number of sucking attempts, and start-up time of lactation phase II were independent factors affecting breastfeeding success in premature infants.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was an independent factor affecting breastfeeding success in premature infants.
